sentences.english: The instructor keeps watching from the side.

sentences.chinese: 教官没有马上说话。
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān méi yǒu mǎ shàng shuō huà 。
sentences.english: The instructor does not speak right away.

sentences.chinese: 只在杂草快没有力气的时候，教官问了一句：“你是在练，还是只是在生气？”
sentences.pinyin: zhī zài zá cǎo kuài méi yǒu lì qi de shí hòu ， jiào guān wèn le yí jù ： “ nǐ shì zài liàn ， hái shì zhǐ shì zài shēng qì ？ ”
sentences.english: Only when Weed is nearly out of strength does the instructor ask, 'Are you training, or are you only being angry?'

sentences.chinese: 这句话让杂草愣住了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jù huà ràng zá cǎo lèng zhù le 。
sentences.english: That sentence stuns Weed.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次停下来，看着手里的木剑，又看着前面的稻草人。
sentences.pinyin: tā dì yī cì tíng xià lái ， kàn zhuó shǒu lǐ de mù jiàn ， yòu kàn zhe qián miàn de dào cǎo rén 。
sentences.english: For the first time, he stops and looks at the wooden sword in his hand, then at the scarecrow in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 杂草突然明白，一直乱打，不等于真正变强。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tū rán míng bái ， yì zhí luàn dǎ ， bù děng yú zhēn zhèng biàn qiáng 。
sentences.english: Weed suddenly understands that wildly hitting all the time does not mean truly becoming stronger.

sentences.chinese: 他不是在跟稻草人练，而是在跟自己心里的怕打。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì zài gēn dào cǎo rén liàn ， ér shì zài gēn zì jǐ xīn lǐ de pà dǎ 。
sentences.english: He is not really training against the scarecrow. He is fighting the fear inside himself.

sentences.chinese: 从那以后，杂草还是继续练，可是方法变了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo hái shì jì xù liàn ， kě shì fāng fǎ biàn le 。
sentences.english: After that, Weed still keeps training, but his method changes.

sentences.chinese: 他先看，再想，然后再打。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān kàn ， zài xiǎng ， rán hòu zài dǎ 。
sentences.english: He first looks, then thinks, and only then hits.

sentences.chinese: 每一下都更稳，也更安静。
sentences.pinyin: měi yí xià dōu gèng wěn ， yě gèng ān jìng 。
sentences.english: Each strike is steadier and calmer.

sentences.chinese: 没过多久，教官走过来，把一个特别任务交给了他。
sentences.pinyin: méi guò duō jiǔ ， jiào guān zǒu guò lái ， bǎ yí gè tè bié rèn wu jiāo gěi le tā 。
sentences.english: Not long later, the instructor walks over and gives him a special quest.

sentences.chinese: 那一刻，杂草才知道，真正让人变强的，不只是吃苦，也是愿意改自己。
sentences.pinyin: nà yí kè ， zá cǎo cái zhī dào ， zhēn zhèng ràng rén biàn qiáng de ， bù zhǐ shì chī kǔ ， yě shì yuàn yì gǎi zì jǐ 。
sentences.english: At that moment, Weed finally knows that what truly makes a person strong is not only enduring hardship, but also being willing to change yourself.

sentences.chinese: 那一天，训练场里的人一个一个走了。
sentences.pinyin: nà yì tiān ， xùn liàn chǎng lǐ de rén yí gè yi gè zǒu le 。
sentences.english: That day, the people in the training yard leave one by one.

sentences.chinese: 有人去吃饭，有人去接任务。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén qù chī fàn ， yǒu rén qù jiē rèn wu 。
sentences.english: Some go to eat, and some go to take quests.

sentences.chinese: 最后只剩下杂草。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu zhī shèng xià zá cǎo 。
sentences.english: In the end, only Weed is left.

sentences.chinese: 他站在木头人前面，反复练同一个动作。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn zài mù tou rén qián miàn ， fǎn fù liàn tóng yí gè dòng zuò 。
sentences.english: He stands in front of the wooden dummy and repeats the same movement.

sentences.chinese: 可是练了很久，还是不对。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì liàn le hěn jiǔ ， hái shì bú duì 。
sentences.english: But even after practicing for a long time, it is still not right.

sentences.chinese: 木剑总是偏一点。
sentences.pinyin: mù jiàn zǒng shì piān yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: The wooden sword is always a little off.

sentences.chinese: 脚也总是慢半步。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo yě zǒng shì màn bàn bù 。
sentences.english: His foot is also always half a beat too slow.

sentences.chinese: 教官在远处看着，没有马上过来。
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān zài yuǎn chù kàn zhe ， méi yǒu mǎ shàng guò lái 。
sentences.english: The instructor watches from far away and does not come over immediately.

sentences.chinese: 杂草心里很急。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo xīn lǐ hěn jí 。
sentences.english: Weed feels very anxious inside.

sentences.chinese: 他知道自己做得不对。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào zì jǐ zuò dé bú duì 。
sentences.english: He knows he is doing it wrong.

sentences.chinese: 可是他不想问。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā bù xiǎng wèn 。
sentences.english: But he does not want to ask.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，自己如果连这种事都要问，说明自己太弱。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， zì jǐ rú guǒ lián zhè zhǒng shì dōu yào wèn ， shuō míng zì jǐ tài ruò 。
sentences.english: In his mind, if he has to ask even about this, it means he is too weak.

sentences.chinese: 所以他只是一直重复。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā zhǐ shì yì zhí chóng fù 。
sentences.english: So he only keeps repeating it.

sentences.chinese: 一次不行，就再来一次。
sentences.pinyin: yí cì bù xíng ， jiù zài lái yí cì 。
sentences.english: If it does not work once, he tries again.

sentences.chinese: 十次不行，就再来十次。
sentences.pinyin: shí cì bù xíng ， jiù zài lái shí cì 。
sentences.english: If it does not work ten times, he does ten more.

sentences.chinese: 可是越这样，他的身体越硬。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yuè zhè yàng ， tā de shēn tǐ yuè yìng 。
sentences.english: But the more he does this, the stiffer his body becomes.

sentences.chinese: 心里也越烦。
sentences.pinyin: xīn lǐ yě yuè fán 。
sentences.english: His mind also becomes more irritated.

sentences.chinese: 后来，教官终于走过来。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， jiào guān zhōng yú zǒu guò lái 。
sentences.english: Later, the instructor finally walks over.

sentences.chinese: 教官没有笑他。
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān méi yǒu xiào tā 。
sentences.english: The instructor does not laugh at him.

sentences.chinese: 教官只是说：“你的手太紧了。”
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān zhǐ shì shuō ： “ nǐ de shǒu tài jǐn le 。 ”
sentences.english: The instructor only says, 'Your hand is too tight.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见以后，脸一下子热了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn yǐ hòu ， liǎn yí xià zǐ rè le 。
sentences.english: After hearing that, Weed's face suddenly feels hot.

sentences.chinese: 因为这句话很简单。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè jù huà hěn jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: Because the sentence is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 简单得像他早一点开口就能得到。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎn dān dé xiàng tā zǎo yì diǎn kāi kǒu jiù néng dé dào 。
sentences.english: It is so simple that he could have gotten it earlier if he had spoken up.

sentences.chinese: 教官又提醒他说：“不是一直用力，就会更强。”
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān yòu tí xǐng tā shuō ： “ bú shì yì zhí yòng lì ， jiù huì gèng qiáng 。 ”
sentences.english: The instructor reminds him again, 'Using force all the time will not make you stronger.'

sentences.chinese: “合适的时候放松，动作才会对。”
sentences.pinyin: “ hé shì de shí hòu fàng sōng ， dòng zuò cái huì duì 。 ”
sentences.english: 'Only when you relax at the right time will the movement be correct.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草这一次没有装作没听见。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhè yí cì méi yǒu zhuāng zuò méi tīng jiàn 。
sentences.english: This time, Weed does not pretend he did not hear it.

sentences.chinese: 他低声问：“那我应该先看哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: tā dī shēng wèn ： “ nà wǒ yīng gāi xiān kàn nǎ lǐ ？ ”
sentences.english: He quietly asks, 'Then where should I look first?'

sentences.chinese: 教官指了指他的手，又指了指他的脚。
sentences.pinyin: jiào guān zhǐ le zhǐ tā de shǒu ， yòu zhǐ le zhǐ tā de jiǎo 。
sentences.english: The instructor points at his hand and then at his foot.

sentences.chinese: 杂草再练一次的时候，真的比刚才顺了很多。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zài liàn yí cì de shí hòu ， zhēn de bǐ gāng cái shùn le hěn duō 。
sentences.english: When Weed practices again, it really feels much smoother than before.

sentences.chinese: 那一刻他才明白，自己刚才不是在坚持。
sentences.pinyin: nà yí kè tā cái míng bái ， zì jǐ gāng cái bú shì zài jiān chí 。
sentences.english: At that moment, he finally understands that what he was doing before was not real perseverance.

sentences.chinese: 自己刚才只是不肯承认，别人也能帮他变强。
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ gāng cái zhǐ shì bù kěn chéng rèn ， bié rén yě néng bāng tā biàn qiáng 。
sentences.english: Before, he simply refused to admit that other people could also help him become stronger.

sentences.chinese: 训练场里还是只有他一个人。
sentences.pinyin: xùn liàn chǎng lǐ hái shì zhǐ yǒu tā yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: There is still only him in the training yard.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，他不再觉得一个人就一定要什么都自己扛。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， tā bú zài jué de yí gè rén jiù yí dìng yào shén me dōu zì jǐ káng 。
sentences.english: But this time, he no longer feels that being alone means carrying everything by himself.

sentences.chinese: 杂草为了一个关于月光的任务，先去找雕刻店的店主，又去酒馆找吟游诗人，后来还去找旧女仆。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo wèi le yí gè guān yú yuè guāng de rèn wu ， xiān qù zhǎo diāo kè diàn de diàn zhǔ ， yòu qù jiǔ guǎn zhǎo yín yóu shī rén ， hòu lái hái qù zhǎo jiù nǚ pú 。
sentences.english: For a quest about moonlight, Weed first goes to the sculpture shop keeper, then to the tavern bard, and later to the old maid.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都只说一点点，没有一个人把话一次说完。
sentences.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu zhī shuō yì diǎn diǎn ， méi yǒu yí gè rén bǎ huà yí cì shuō wán 。
sentences.english: Each person says only a little. No one says everything at once.

sentences.chinese: 杂草本来就不是喜欢听故事的人。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo běn lái jiù bú shì xǐ huan tīng gù shì de rén 。
sentences.english: Weed was never a person who liked listening to stories.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得故事太慢，也太远。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de gù shì tài màn ， yě tài yuǎn 。
sentences.english: He feels stories are too slow and too far away.

sentences.chinese: 故事不能马上变成钱，也不能马上让人变强。
sentences.pinyin: gù shì bù néng mǎ shàng biàn chéng qián ， yě bù néng mǎ shàng ràng rén biàn qiáng 。
sentences.english: Stories cannot immediately turn into money, and they cannot immediately make a person stronger.

sentences.chinese: 所以他一开始只想快点听完，快点离开。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā yì kāi shǐ zhī xiǎng kuài diǎn tīng wán ， kuài diǎn lí kāi 。
sentences.english: So at first he only wants to hear it quickly and leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 可是事情没有那么简单。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì shì qíng méi yǒu nà me jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: But things are not that simple.

sentences.chinese: 店主只告诉他王宫里有一个旧传说。
sentences.pinyin: diàn zhǔ zhī gào sù tā wáng gōng lǐ yǒu yí gè jiù chuán shuō 。
sentences.english: The shopkeeper only tells him that there is an old legend in the royal palace.

sentences.chinese: 吟游诗人只唱了几句歌。
sentences.pinyin: yín yóu shī rén zhī chàng le jǐ jù gē 。
sentences.english: The bard sings only a few lines.

sentences.chinese: 旧女仆又一直说从前的事。
sentences.pinyin: jiù nǚ pú yòu yì zhí shuō cóng qián de shì 。
sentences.english: The old maid keeps talking about things from the past.

sentences.chinese: 杂草越听越烦，差一点就想走。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yuè tīng yuè fán ， chà yì diǎn jiù xiǎng zǒu 。
sentences.english: The more Weed listens, the more annoyed he gets, and he almost wants to leave.

sentences.chinese: 他心里一直有一个想法：只有马上有用的东西，才值得花时间。
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn lǐ yì zhí yǒu yí gè xiǎng fǎ ： zhǐ yǒu mǎ shàng yǒu yòng de dōng xī ， cái zhí dé huā shí jiān 。
sentences.english: He keeps thinking that only things that are useful right away are worth spending time on.

sentences.chinese: 听这些旧话，太浪费时间了。
sentences.pinyin: tīng zhè xiē jiù huà ， tài làng fèi shí jiān le 。
sentences.english: Listening to all these old words is too much of a waste of time.

sentences.chinese: 但当他真的站起来准备离开时，他忽然想到自己在训练场的日子。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dāng tā zhēn de zhàn qǐ lái zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí ， tā hū rán xiǎng dào zì jǐ zài xùn liàn chǎng de rì zi 。
sentences.english: But when he really stands up to leave, he suddenly thinks about his days in the training hall.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，别人也觉得打稻草人没有用。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hòu ， bié rén yě jué de dǎ dào cǎo rén méi yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: At that time, other people also thought hitting the scarecrow was useless.

sentences.chinese: 可是正是那些看起来没用的时间，让他后来拿到了任务。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhèng shì nà xiē kàn qǐ lái méi yòng de shí jiān ， ràng tā hòu lái ná dào le rèn wu 。
sentences.english: But it was exactly that seemingly useless time that later got him the quest.

sentences.chinese: 想到这里，他又坐下来了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ ， tā yòu zuò xià lái le 。
sentences.english: When he thinks of this, he sits back down.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，他不再只想“快点结束”，而是开始认真听，认真问，也认真把每个人的话放在一起想。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， tā bú zài zhī xiǎng “ kuài diǎn jié shù ” ， ér shì kāi shǐ rèn zhēn tīng ， rèn zhēn wèn ， yě rèn zhēn bǎ měi gè rén de huà fàng zài yì qǐ xiǎng 。
sentences.english: This time, he no longer only wants it to end quickly. He starts to listen carefully, ask carefully, and think carefully about everyone's words together.

sentences.chinese: 慢慢地，一条线在他眼前清楚起来。
sentences.pinyin: màn màn dì ， yì tiáo xiàn zài tā yǎn qián qīng chǔ qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: Slowly, one line becomes clear in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 月光不是普通的名字，扎哈布也不是普通的雕刻家。
sentences.pinyin: yuè guāng bú shì pǔ tōng de míng zì ， zhā hā bù yě bú shì pǔ tōng de diāo kè jiā 。
sentences.english: Moonlight is not an ordinary name, and Zahab is not an ordinary sculptor.

sentences.chinese: 那份约定、那个夜晚、那把像剑一样的雕刻刀，原来都连在一起。
sentences.pinyin: nà fèn yuē dìng 、 nà ge yè wǎn 、 nà bǎ xiàng jiàn yí yàng de diāo kè dāo ， yuán lái dōu lián zài yì qǐ 。
sentences.english: That promise, that night, and that sculpting knife like a sword all turn out to be connected.

sentences.chinese: 最后，杂草得到了月光雕刻师的路。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， zá cǎo dé dào le yuè guāng diāo kè shī de lù 。
sentences.english: In the end, Weed finds the path of the Moonlight Sculptor.

sentences.chinese: 以前的他也许会因为怕麻烦而转身就走，这一次他却没有。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián de tā yě xǔ huì yīn wèi pà má fán ér zhuǎn shēn jiù zǒu ， zhè yí cì tā què méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: In the past, he might have turned around and left because he feared trouble, but this time he does not.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，有些最好的东西，不会大声叫你过去。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhōng yú míng bái ， yǒu xiē zuì hǎo de dōng xī ， bú huì dà shēng jiào nǐ guò qù 。
sentences.english: He finally understands that some of the best things do not loudly call you over.

sentences.chinese: 你要先安静下来，才会真的听见。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yào xiān ān jìng xià lái ， cái huì zhēn de tīng jiàn 。
sentences.english: You have to become quiet first before you can really hear.

sentences.chinese: 杂草找到旧女仆的时候，天已经不早了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhǎo dào jiù nǚ pú de shí hòu ， tiān yǐ jīng bù zǎo le 。
sentences.english: By the time Weed finds the old maid, it is already getting late.

sentences.chinese: 旧女仆走得很慢，说话也很慢。
sentences.pinyin: jiù nǚ pú zǒu dé hěn màn ， shuō huà yě hěn màn 。
sentences.english: The old maid walks slowly and also speaks slowly.

sentences.chinese: 她先说王宫的花。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān shuō wáng gōng de huā 。
sentences.english: She first talks about the flowers in the palace.

sentences.chinese: 后来又说以前的天气。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yòu shuō yǐ qián de tiān qì 。
sentences.english: Later she talks about the weather in the past.

sentences.chinese: 再后来，她开始说一个很久以前的晚上。
sentences.pinyin: zài hòu lái ， tā kāi shǐ shuō yí gè hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de wǎn shàng 。
sentences.english: After that, she starts talking about a night from long ago.

sentences.chinese: 杂草一开始还认真听。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yì kāi shǐ hái rèn zhēn tīng 。
sentences.english: At first, Weed listens seriously.

sentences.chinese: 可是听了一会儿以后，他心里又急了。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tīng le yí huì er yǐ hòu ， tā xīn lǐ yòu jí le 。
sentences.english: But after listening for a while, he becomes impatient again.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得真正的线索一定早就说完了。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zhēn zhèng de xiàn suǒ yí dìng zǎo jiù shuō wán le 。
sentences.english: He feels that the real clue must already have been said.

sentences.chinese: 后面这些旧话，只是在拖时间。
sentences.pinyin: hòu miàn zhè xiē jiù huà ， zhǐ shì zài tuō shí jiān 。
sentences.english: These old words afterward are only dragging out time.

sentences.chinese: 他站起来一次。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn qǐ lái yí cì 。
sentences.english: He stands up once.

sentences.chinese: 可是旧女仆没有看他。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì jiù nǚ pú méi yǒu kàn tā 。
sentences.english: But the old maid does not look at him.

sentences.chinese: 她还是慢慢往下说。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái shì màn màn wǎng xià shuō 。
sentences.english: She simply keeps talking slowly.

sentences.chinese: 杂草又坐下。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yòu zuò xià 。
sentences.english: Weed sits down again.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉自己，再听一点。
sentences.pinyin: tā gào sù zì jǐ ， zài tīng yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: He tells himself to listen a little longer.

sentences.chinese: 可是再过一会儿，他又差不多想走。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zài guò yí huì er ， tā yòu chà bù duō xiǎng zǒu 。
sentences.english: But after a little more time, he almost wants to leave again.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，耐心一直不是很有用的东西。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， nài xīn yì zhí bú shì hěn yǒu yòng de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: In his mind, patience has never been a very useful thing.

sentences.chinese: 他更相信快一点、准一点。
sentences.pinyin: tā gèng xiāng xìn kuài yì diǎn 、 zhǔn yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: He trusts speed and accuracy more.

sentences.chinese: 可就在他准备第二次站起来的时候，旧女仆忽然提到了一把刀。
sentences.pinyin: kě jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi dì èr cì zhàn qǐ lái de shí hòu ， jiù nǚ pú hū rán tí dào le yì bǎ dāo 。
sentences.english: But just as he gets ready to stand up a second time, the old maid suddenly mentions a knife.

sentences.chinese: 那不是普通的刀。
sentences.pinyin: nà bú shì pǔ tōng de dāo 。
sentences.english: It is not an ordinary knife.

sentences.chinese: 那把刀只在月亮很亮的晚上出现。
sentences.pinyin: nà bǎ dāo zhī zài yuè liàng hěn liàng de wǎn shàng chū xiàn 。
sentences.english: That knife appears only on nights when the moon is bright.

sentences.chinese: 杂草一下子坐直了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yí xià zǐ zuò zhí le 。
sentences.english: Weed suddenly sits up straight.

sentences.chinese: 旧女仆说得还是很慢。
sentences.pinyin: jiù nǚ pú shuō dé hái shì hěn màn 。
sentences.english: The old maid is still speaking slowly.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草这一次一句也不敢漏。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo zhè yí cì yí jù yě bù gǎn lòu 。
sentences.english: But this time, Weed does not dare miss a single sentence.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至开始把几个重要的词记下。
sentences.pinyin: tā shèn zhì kāi shǐ bǎ jǐ gè zhòng yào de cí jì xià 。
sentences.english: He even begins to write down a few important words.

sentences.chinese: 旧女仆最后说完的时候，天已经黑了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù nǚ pú zuì hòu shuō wán de shí hòu ， tiān yǐ jīng hēi le 。
sentences.english: By the time the old maid finishes, it is already dark.

sentences.chinese: 杂草却一点也不觉得浪费。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo què yì diǎn yě bù jué de làng fèi 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not feel that it was a waste at all.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，重要的话不一定会在最前面。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhōng yú míng bái ， zhòng yào de huà bù yí dìng huì zài zuì qián miàn 。
sentences.english: He finally understands that important words do not always come first.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，最关键的一句会躲在最后。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu ， zuì guān jiàn de yí jù huì duǒ zài zuì hòu 。
sentences.english: Sometimes the most important sentence hides at the end.

sentences.chinese: 他离开的时候，脚步比来的时候更快。
sentences.pinyin: tā lí kāi de shí hòu ， jiǎo bù bǐ lái de shí hòu gèng kuài 。
sentences.english: When he leaves, his steps are quicker than when he arrived.

sentences.chinese: 可是他的心，比刚来的时候更稳。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā de xīn ， bǐ gāng lái de shí hòu gèng wěn 。
sentences.english: But his heart is steadier than when he first came.

sentences.chinese: 杂草终于走到了可以换职业的时候。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhōng yú zǒu dào le kě yǐ huàn zhí yè de shí hòu 。
sentences.english: Weed finally reaches the point where he can change class.

sentences.chinese: 很多人都很兴奋。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén dōu hěn xīng fèn 。
sentences.english: Many people are excited.

sentences.chinese: 有人想做骑士。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén xiǎng zuò qí shì 。
sentences.english: Some want to become knights.

sentences.chinese: 有人想做魔法师。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén xiǎng zuò mó fǎ shī 。
sentences.english: Some want to become mages.

sentences.chinese: 大家都在说什么职业最强。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu zài shuō shén me zhí yè zuì qiáng 。
sentences.english: Everyone is talking about which class is strongest.

sentences.chinese: 杂草没有马上说话。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo méi yǒu mǎ shàng shuō huà 。
sentences.english: Weed does not speak right away.

sentences.chinese: 他站在一边，先看别人怎么选。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn zài yì biān ， xiān kàn bié rén zěn me xuǎn 。
sentences.english: He stands to the side and first watches how other people choose.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他听见有人提到雕刻师。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， tā tīng jiàn yǒu rén tí dào diāo kè shī 。
sentences.english: Later, he hears someone mention sculptor.

sentences.chinese: 那个人一说完，旁边的人都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén yì shuō wán ， páng biān de rén dōu xiào le 。
sentences.english: As soon as that person finishes speaking, the people nearby all laugh.

sentences.chinese: 有人说：“那种职业能做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén shuō ： “ nà zhǒng zhí yè néng zuò shén me ？ ”
sentences.english: Someone says, 'What can that class even do?'

sentences.chinese: 还有人说：“选那个，不如什么都不选。”
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu rén shuō ： “ xuǎn nà ge ， bù rú shén me dōu bù xuǎn 。 ”
sentences.english: Another person says, 'Choosing that is almost the same as choosing nothing.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见这些话，心里当然也动了一下。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn zhè xiē huà ， xīn lǐ dāng rán yě dòng le yí xià 。
sentences.english: When Weed hears those words, his heart naturally wavers a little.

sentences.chinese: 他最怕的，不是难。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuì pà de ， bú shì nán 。
sentences.english: What he fears most is not difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 他最怕的是，自己花了很久，最后还是没有钱，也没有路。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuì pà de shì ， zì jǐ huā le hěn jiǔ ， zuì hòu hái shì méi yǒu qián ， yě méi yǒu lù 。
sentences.english: What he fears most is spending a long time and ending with no money and no path.

sentences.chinese: 所以他的老想法又出来了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā de lǎo xiǎng fǎ yòu chū lái le 。
sentences.english: So his old way of thinking appears again.

sentences.chinese: 看起来强的，应该比较安全。
sentences.pinyin: kàn qǐ lái qiáng de ， yīng gāi bǐ jiào ān quán 。
sentences.english: What looks strong should be safer.

sentences.chinese: 看起来有名的，应该比较容易走。
sentences.pinyin: kàn qǐ lái yǒu míng de ， yīng gāi bǐ jiào róng yì zǒu 。
sentences.english: What looks famous should be easier to follow.

sentences.chinese: 可是他又想到一件事。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā yòu xiǎng dào yí jiàn shì 。
sentences.english: But then he thinks of something else.

sentences.chinese: 真正有用的东西，不一定会在表面上写出来。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn zhèng yǒu yòng de dōng xī ， bù yí dìng huì zài biǎo miàn shàng xiě chū lái 。
sentences.english: Something truly useful is not always written on the surface.

sentences.chinese: 如果每个人都觉得一个职业没用，也许只是因为他们只看今天。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ měi gè rén dōu jué de yí gè zhí yè méi yòng ， yě xǔ zhǐ shì yīn wèi tā men zhī kàn jīn tiān 。
sentences.english: If everyone thinks a class is useless, maybe it is only because they are looking at today.

sentences.chinese: 杂草却总是看得更长远。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo què zǒng shì kàn dé gèng cháng yuǎn 。
sentences.english: But Weed always tries to look further ahead.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢走过去。
sentences.pinyin: tā màn màn zǒu guò qù 。
sentences.english: He slowly walks over.

sentences.chinese: 周围的人还在把雕刻师当笑话。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu wéi de rén hái zài bǎ diāo kè shī dāng xiào huà 。
sentences.english: The people around are still treating sculptor as a joke.

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见了，可是没有回头。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn le ， kě shì méi yǒu huí tóu 。
sentences.english: Weed hears them, but he does not turn back.

sentences.chinese: 他做出了自己的选择。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò chū le zì jǐ de xuǎn zé 。
sentences.english: He makes his own choice.

sentences.chinese: 那一刻，没有掌声。
sentences.pinyin: nà yí kè ， méi yǒu zhǎng shēng 。
sentences.english: At that moment, there is no applause.

sentences.chinese: 也没有人觉得他很聪明。
sentences.pinyin: yě méi yǒu rén jué de tā hěn cōng ming 。
sentences.english: And no one thinks he is very clever.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草心里反而安静。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo xīn lǐ fǎn ér ān jìng 。
sentences.english: But inside, Weed actually feels calm.

sentences.chinese: 因为他终于不是照着别人的眼睛选路。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā zhōng yú bú shì zhào zhe bié rén de yǎn jīng xuǎn lù 。
sentences.english: Because he is finally not choosing his path by other people's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他是在照着自己最清楚的地方走。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì zài zhào zhe zì jǐ zuì qīng chǔ de dì fāng zǒu 。
sentences.english: He is following the part he understands most clearly himself.

sentences.chinese: 换了职业以后，杂草拿到了一把小小的雕刻刀。
sentences.pinyin: huàn le zhí yè yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo ná dào le yì bǎ xiǎo xiǎo de diāo kè dāo 。
sentences.english: After changing class, Weed receives a small sculpting knife.

sentences.chinese: 那把刀不像剑。
sentences.pinyin: nà bǎ dāo bú xiàng jiàn 。
sentences.english: That knife does not look like a sword.

sentences.chinese: 也不像别人的高级武器。
sentences.pinyin: yě bú xiàng bié rén de gāo jí wǔ qì 。
sentences.english: It also does not look like other people's high-level weapons.

sentences.chinese: 它很短，也很安静。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn duǎn ， yě hěn ān jìng 。
sentences.english: It is short and quiet.

sentences.chinese: 杂草把它拿在手里，先没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bǎ tā ná zài shǒu lǐ ， xiān méi yǒu shuō huà 。
sentences.english: Weed holds it in his hand and says nothing at first.

sentences.chinese: 他本来以为，真正能改变人的东西，应该看起来更厉害一点。
sentences.pinyin: tā běn lái yǐ wéi ， zhēn zhèng néng gǎi biàn rén de dōng xī ， yīng gāi kàn qǐ lái gèng lì hài yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: He had thought that something truly able to change a person should look more impressive.

sentences.chinese: 至少，也应该大一点。
sentences.pinyin: zhì shǎo ， yě yīng gāi dà yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: At least, it should be bigger.

sentences.chinese: 可是现在，他手里只有这一把小刀。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài ， tā shǒu lǐ zhǐ yǒu zhè yì bǎ xiǎo dāo 。
sentences.english: But now, there is only this little knife in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 旁边的人看见了，又有人笑。
sentences.pinyin: páng biān de rén kàn jiàn le ， yòu yǒu rén xiào 。
sentences.english: People nearby see it, and some laugh again.

sentences.chinese: 有人说：“这也算武器吗？”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén shuō ： “ zhè yě suàn wǔ qì ma ？ ”
sentences.english: Someone says, 'Does that even count as a weapon?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草这次没有理他们。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhè cì méi yǒu lǐ tā men 。
sentences.english: This time, Weed does not pay attention to them.

sentences.chinese: 他只是低头看着刀。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì dī tóu kàn zhe dāo 。
sentences.english: He only looks down at the knife.

sentences.chinese: 刀口很锋利。
sentences.pinyin: dāo kǒu hěn fēng lì 。
sentences.english: The edge is very sharp.

sentences.chinese: 他的手指刚碰上去，就马上收回来。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shǒu zhǐ gāng pèng shàng qù ， jiù mǎ shàng shōu huí lái 。
sentences.english: As soon as his finger touches it, he pulls back at once.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然明白，这种东西不是用来乱挥的。
sentences.pinyin: tā hū rán míng bái ， zhè zhǒng dōng xī bú shì yòng lái luàn huī de 。
sentences.english: He suddenly understands that this kind of thing is not for swinging around carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 这种东西要小心。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng dōng xī yào xiǎo xīn 。
sentences.english: This kind of thing needs care.

sentences.chinese: 要轻轻地用。
sentences.pinyin: yào qīng qīng dì yòng 。
sentences.english: It has to be used lightly.

sentences.chinese: 也要认真地看。
sentences.pinyin: yě yào rèn zhēn dì kàn 。
sentences.english: And it has to be watched carefully.

sentences.chinese: 杂草以前一直相信，力气大一点，就会更快。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yǐ qián yì zhí xiāng xìn ， lì qi dà yì diǎn ， jiù huì gèng kuài 。
sentences.english: Weed used to believe that more force would make things faster.

sentences.chinese: 可是这把刀给他的感觉完全不一样。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè bǎ dāo gěi tā de gǎn jué wán quán bù yí yàng 。
sentences.english: But this knife gives him a completely different feeling.

sentences.chinese: 这把刀像是在说，快没有用。
sentences.pinyin: zhè bǎ dāo xiàng shì zài shuō ， kuài méi yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: The knife seems to say that speed is useless here.

sentences.chinese: 乱也没有用。
sentences.pinyin: luàn yě méi yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: Being careless is useless too.

sentences.chinese: 如果真的想做出东西，就要先安静下来。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zhēn de xiǎng zuò chū dōng xī ， jiù yào xiān ān jìng xià lái 。
sentences.english: If he truly wants to make something, he first has to become calm.

sentences.chinese: 杂草把刀收好。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bǎ dāo shōu hǎo 。
sentences.english: Weed puts the knife away carefully.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，他没有把它当成一个小东西。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， tā méi yǒu bǎ tā dàng chéng yí gè xiǎo dōng xī 。
sentences.english: This time, he does not treat it as something small.

sentences.chinese: 他开始珍惜这把刀。
sentences.pinyin: tā kāi shǐ zhēn xī zhè bǎ dāo 。
sentences.english: He begins to treasure this knife.

sentences.chinese: 因为他觉得，也许真正大的改变，本来就不是从大东西开始。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā jué de ， yě xǔ zhēn zhèng dà de gǎi biàn ， běn lái jiù bú shì cóng dà dōng xī kāi shǐ 。
sentences.english: Because he feels that maybe truly big change does not begin with big things at all.

sentences.chinese: 杂草第一次正式练雕刻的时候，面前只放着一块普通木头。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo dì yī cì zhèng shì liàn diāo kè de shí hòu ， miàn qián zhī fàng zhe yí kuài pǔ tōng mù tou 。
sentences.english: The first time Weed formally practices sculpting, there is only an ordinary piece of wood in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 那块木头一点也不特别。
sentences.pinyin: nà kuài mù tou yì diǎn yě bú tè bié 。
sentences.english: That piece of wood is not special at all.

sentences.chinese: 又小，又旧。
sentences.pinyin: yòu xiǎo ， yòu jiù 。
sentences.english: It is small and worn.

sentences.chinese: 杂草一开始有点失望。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yì kāi shǐ yǒu diǎn shī wàng 。
sentences.english: At first, Weed feels a little disappointed.

sentences.chinese: 他本来以为，第一件东西至少应该让人一看就觉得厉害。
sentences.pinyin: tā běn lái yǐ wéi ， dì yī jiàn dōng xī zhì shǎo yīng gāi ràng rén yí kàn jiù jué de lì hài 。
sentences.english: He had thought that the first thing should at least look impressive at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 可是现在，他只好先低头做。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài ， tā zhǐ hǎo xiān dī tóu zuò 。
sentences.english: But now, he can only lower his head and start working.

sentences.chinese: 第一刀下去的时候，他太快了。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī dāo xià qù de shí hòu ， tā tài kuài le 。
sentences.english: When the first cut goes down, he is too fast.

sentences.chinese: 木头马上歪了一边。
sentences.pinyin: mù tou mǎ shàng wāi le yì biān 。
sentences.english: The wood immediately goes crooked on one side.

sentences.chinese: 杂草看着那一块坏掉的地方，心里很不高兴。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe nà yí kuài huài diào de dì fāng ， xīn lǐ hěn bù gāo xìng 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at the damaged part and feels unhappy.

sentences.chinese: 他又试一次。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu shì yí cì 。
sentences.english: He tries again.

sentences.chinese: 这一次慢一点。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì màn yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: This time, he goes a little slower.

sentences.chinese: 可是线还是不直。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn hái shì bù zhí 。
sentences.english: But the line is still not straight.

sentences.chinese: 他本来以为，有决心就够了。
sentences.pinyin: tā běn lái yǐ wéi ， yǒu jué xīn jiù gòu le 。
sentences.english: He had thought that determination alone would be enough.

sentences.chinese: 现在他才发现，手也要跟上。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā cái fā xiàn ， shǒu yě yào gēn shàng 。
sentences.english: Now he finds that his hands also have to catch up.

sentences.chinese: 眼睛也要跟上。
sentences.pinyin: yǎn jīng yě yào gēn shàng 。
sentences.english: His eyes also have to catch up.

sentences.chinese: 心也要跟上。
sentences.pinyin: xīn yě yào gēn shàng 。
sentences.english: And his mind also has to catch up.

sentences.chinese: 杂草坐了一会儿，没有马上再下刀。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zuò le yí huì er ， méi yǒu mǎ shàng zài xià dāo 。
sentences.english: Weed sits for a while and does not cut again right away.

sentences.chinese: 他先看着那块木头。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān kàn zhe nà kuài mù tou 。
sentences.english: He first looks at the piece of wood.

sentences.chinese: 后来又看着自己手里的刀。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yòu kàn zhe zì jǐ shǒu lǐ de dāo 。
sentences.english: Then he looks at the knife in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他轻轻地呼了一口气。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， tā qīng qīng dì hū le yì kǒu qì 。
sentences.english: Finally, he lets out a soft breath.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，他决定重新来。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， tā jué dìng chóng xīn lái 。
sentences.english: This time, he decides to start again.

sentences.chinese: 不是为了快。
sentences.pinyin: bú shì wèi le kuài 。
sentences.english: Not for speed.

sentences.chinese: 也不是为了马上做出很大的东西。
sentences.pinyin: yě bú shì wèi le mǎ shàng zuò chū hěn dà de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: And not to immediately make something grand.

sentences.chinese: 他只想先把一个小小的表情做对。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī xiǎng xiān bǎ yí gè xiǎo xiǎo de biǎo qíng zuò duì 。
sentences.english: He only wants to get one small expression right first.

sentences.chinese: 一点一点地，木头终于没有再乱掉。
sentences.pinyin: yì diǎn yi diǎn dì ， mù tou zhōng yú méi yǒu zài luàn diào 。
sentences.english: Bit by bit, the wood finally stops going wrong.

sentences.chinese: 做完以后，那东西还是很简单。
sentences.pinyin: zuò wán yǐ hòu ， nà dōng xī hái shì hěn jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: After finishing, the thing is still very simple.

sentences.chinese: 也说不上多好看。
sentences.pinyin: yě shuō bú shàng duō hǎo kàn 。
sentences.english: You could not call it very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo kàn le hěn jiǔ 。
sentences.english: But Weed looks at it for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，他没有笑自己。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， tā méi yǒu xiào zì jǐ 。
sentences.english: This time, he does not laugh at himself.

sentences.chinese: 因为他第一次明白，不满意的时候，不一定要生气。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā dì yī cì míng bái ， bù mǎn yì de shí hòu ， bù yí dìng yào shēng qì 。
sentences.english: Because for the first time, he understands that when you are unsatisfied, you do not always have to get angry.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，你只要安静地再做一次。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu ， nǐ zhǐ yào ān jìng dì zài zuò yí cì 。
sentences.english: Sometimes, you only need to quietly do it one more time.

sentences.chinese: 杂草做出第一件还算像样的东西以后，把它带到了市场。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zuò chū dì yī jiàn hái suàn xiàng yàng de dōng xī yǐ hòu ， bǎ tā dài dào le shì chǎng 。
sentences.english: After making his first passable piece, Weed brings it to the market.

sentences.chinese: 市场里有很多摊位。
sentences.pinyin: shì chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō tān wèi 。
sentences.english: There are many stalls in the market.

sentences.chinese: 也有很多人在大声说话。
sentences.pinyin: yě yǒu hěn duō rén zài dà shēng shuō huà 。
sentences.english: There are also many people speaking loudly.

sentences.chinese: 有人卖武器。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén mài wǔ qì 。
sentences.english: Some people are selling weapons.

sentences.chinese: 有人卖衣服。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén mài yī fu 。
sentences.english: Some are selling clothes.

sentences.chinese: 杂草手里拿着自己的小雕刻，看起来很不起眼。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo shǒu lǐ ná zhe zì jǐ de xiǎo diāo kè ， kàn qǐ lái hěn bù qǐ yǎn 。
sentences.english: Weed holds his small sculpture in his hand, and it does not stand out much.

sentences.chinese: 他一开始站得很直。
sentences.pinyin: tā yì kāi shǐ zhàn dé hěn zhí 。
sentences.english: At first he stands very straight.

sentences.chinese: 好像只要自己站得稳一点，别人就会觉得那东西也不错。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng zhǐ yào zì jǐ zhàn dé wěn yì diǎn ， bié rén jiù huì jué de nà dōng xī yě bú cuò 。
sentences.english: As if standing more firmly would make others think the piece is good too.

sentences.chinese: 可是第一个看见的人笑了。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì dì yī gè kàn jiàn de rén xiào le 。
sentences.english: But the first person who sees it laughs.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人也笑了。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr gè rén yě xiào le 。
sentences.english: The second person also laughs.

sentences.chinese: 后来还有人直接取笑他。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái hái yǒu rén zhí jiē qǔ xiào tā 。
sentences.english: Later, someone directly mocks him.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“这个也有人要吗？”
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén shuō ： “ zhè ge yě yǒu rén yào ma ？ ”
sentences.english: That person says, 'Would anyone even want this?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见以后，手一下子冷了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn yǐ hòu ， shǒu yí xià zǐ lěng le 。
sentences.english: After hearing that, Weed's hand suddenly feels cold.

sentences.chinese: 他差一点就想把东西收起来。
sentences.pinyin: tā chà yì diǎn jiù xiǎng bǎ dōng xī shōu qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: He almost wants to put the piece away.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，一个老想法又出来了。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， yí gè lǎo xiǎng fǎ yòu chū lái le 。
sentences.english: In his heart, an old thought appears again.

sentences.chinese: 如果大部分人都笑，说明这东西一定没有用。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dà bù fen rén dōu xiào ， shuō míng zhè dōng xī yí dìng méi yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: If most people laugh, then this thing must be useless.

sentences.chinese: 可是就在这时候，一个老人走到了他面前。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì jiù zài zhè shí hòu ， yí gè lǎo rén zǒu dào le tā miàn qián 。
sentences.english: But at that moment, an old man walks up in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 老人没有笑。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén méi yǒu xiào 。
sentences.english: The old man does not laugh.

sentences.chinese: 老人只是低头看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén zhǐ shì dī tóu kàn le hěn jiǔ 。
sentences.english: He only lowers his head and looks for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 后来，老人轻轻点头。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， lǎo rén qīng qīng diǎn tóu 。
sentences.english: Later, the old man nods lightly.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这东西还不成熟。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén shuō ： “ zhè dōng xī hái bù chéng shú 。
sentences.english: The old man says, 'This piece is not mature yet.'

sentences.chinese: 可是做它的人很认真。”
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zuò tā de rén hěn rèn zhēn 。 ”
sentences.english: 'But the person who made it was serious.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见这句话，心里忽然一静。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn zhè jù huà ， xīn lǐ hū rán yí jìng 。
sentences.english: When Weed hears that sentence, his heart suddenly becomes quiet.

sentences.chinese: 因为老人看到的，不只是东西本身。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi lǎo rén kàn dào de ， bù zhǐ shì dōng xī běn shēn 。
sentences.english: Because the old man sees not only the object itself.

sentences.chinese: 老人也看见了他花在上面的时间。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yě kàn jiàn le tā huā zài shàng miàn de shí jiān 。
sentences.english: He also sees the time Weed put into it.

sentences.chinese: 看见了他没有放弃的样子。
sentences.pinyin: kàn jiàn le tā méi yǒu fàng qì de yàng zi 。
sentences.english: He sees the way Weed did not give up.

sentences.chinese: 杂草最后没有把那件东西丢掉。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zuì hòu méi yǒu bǎ nà jiàn dōng xī diū diào 。
sentences.english: In the end, Weed does not throw the piece away.

sentences.chinese: 他反而把它收得更好。
sentences.pinyin: tā fǎn ér bǎ tā shōu dé gèng hǎo 。
sentences.english: Instead, he puts it away more carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，不是每个人的笑声都一样重要。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhōng yú míng bái ， bú shì měi gè rén de xiào shēng dōu yí yàng zhòng yào 。
sentences.english: He finally understands that not everyone's laughter is equally important.

sentences.chinese: 只要有一个人真的看见了，你做的事就值得继续。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào yǒu yí gè rén zhēn de kàn jiàn le ， nǐ zuò de shì jiù zhí dé jì xù 。
sentences.english: As long as one person truly sees it, what you are doing is worth continuing.
